verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents a keyboard shortcuts reference page with a Shift+? overlay (shortwave-docs-49), and Tab accepts AI autocomplete suggestions (shortwave-docs-13). One community user praised the interface's speed (shortwave-comm-2). The pack does not show how comprehensive the shortcuts are, and it never mentions a command palette. missing for 10: evidence of a command palette, documentation showing shortcut coverage across all actions, independent hands-on corroboration of keyboard-only workflows and consistently instant performance.
